scenes.name: YOU WAKE UP
scenes.desc: Morning. An extreme close-up of a man's eyes opening on the pillow. His phone buzzes: a BREAKING NEWS alert - every man on Earth has disappeared. He sits bolt upright in bed.
scenes.actions: The main character (the only man in the film): early thirties, short dark hair, light stubble, grey T-shirt, dark sweatpants. Sleepy -> puzzled -> shocked.
scenes.lighting: Soft morning light through the blinds; the phone's glow on his face.
scenes.sfx: A phone buzz and a news-alert chime; a breaking-news sting on "Except you."
scenes.edit: No introduction: the first frame is his eyes opening. Fast cuts. Key caption: EXCEPT YOU.

shots.name: wake
shots.camera: extreme close-up of the eyes opening; slow drift

shots.name: phone
shots.camera: over the shoulder onto the phone screen: BREAKING NEWS alert

shots.name: sit
shots.camera: medium shot from the foot of the bed as he sits up; quick push in

scenes.name: THE WORLD FINDS OUT
scenes.desc: The TV on his wall: a news presenter in front of BREAKING NEWS graphics. A city square full of women staring up at giant screens. A newsroom wall of screens: a world map lit up with alerts. Then his own ID photo on the news: THE ONLY MAN ALIVE.
scenes.actions: He stares at the TV, frozen. The crowds look up; the presenter talks.
scenes.lighting: Cold TV light; daylight in the square; newsroom blues and reds.
scenes.sfx: News stings, a crowd murmur in the square, a whoosh on every cut, the music building.
scenes.edit: Very fast broadcast-style cuts with glitches. Key caption: THE ONLY MAN ALIVE.

shots.name: tv
shots.camera: over his shoulder to the TV; slow push

shots.name: square
shots.camera: low, looking up past the crowd at the giant screens; crane up

shots.name: newsroom
shots.camera: tracking along the newsroom wall of screens

shots.name: only
shots.camera: close on a screen with his ID photo, pulling back to reveal it is on every screen

scenes.name: THE SEARCH
scenes.desc: In the bathroom mirror he splashes his face - not a dream. Helicopters circle his apartment tower. Scientists study his scans on a wall of screens. Reporters and camera crews pack the street below. He peeks through the curtains.
scenes.actions: Splashing water, staring at himself; peeking out, confused.
scenes.lighting: Bright bathroom; overcast daylight outside; a white lab with blue screens.
scenes.sfx: Running water; helicopter rotors; lab beeps; a crowd of reporters shouting (indistinct), camera shutters.
scenes.edit: Cuts on the beat; the music grows.

shots.name: mirror
shots.camera: over his shoulder into the mirror; slow push

shots.name: heli
shots.camera: aerial orbit: helicopters around his tower

shots.name: lab
shots.camera: slow dolly behind scientists at a wall of screens

shots.name: reporters
shots.camera: low among the reporters, cameras pointed up at his window

shots.name: curtain
shots.camera: close on his face peeking between the curtains

scenes.name: THE WORLD DOES NOT STOP
scenes.desc: The twist: everything keeps running. A busy street with traffic and women walking to work; an office; a hospital corridor; a parliament in session; a train pulling in, packed with commuters.
scenes.actions: Everyday life: walking, working, debating, commuting.
scenes.lighting: Bright, warm, ordinary daylight - the opposite of a disaster film.
scenes.sfx: City traffic, office chatter (indistinct), a hospital pager, a gavel, a train arriving; upbeat music.
scenes.edit: A rhythmic montage, one cut per word. Key caption: THE WORLD DOESN'T STOP.

shots.name: train
shots.camera: platform-level as the train pulls in

scenes.name: THE PAYOFF
scenes.desc: Dusk in his flat. He stands with his back to the window; across the street a giant screen shows his face and THE LAST MAN ALIVE. The camera pushes in until only his eyes fill the frame (the first shot is his eyes, so it loops).
scenes.actions: Hands in pockets, a small, bewildered half-smile; he looks straight at us.
scenes.lighting: Blue dusk outside; the screen's light on his back; a warm lamp on his face.
scenes.sfx: The music swells and stops; a last news-alert chime.
scenes.edit: One long push-in. Key caption: THE BIGGEST MYSTERY ON IT.

shots.name: payoff
shots.camera: slow push from a wide shot to an extreme close-up of his eyes

lines.text: You wake up, and every man on Earth has disappeared. Except you.
lines.tts: You wake up, and every man on Earth has disappeared. Except you.

lines.text: Suddenly, news stations worldwide are reporting the same thing. You're officially the only man alive.
lines.tts: Suddenly, news stations worldwide are reporting the same thing. You're officially the only man alive.

lines.text: At first, you think you're dreaming. But governments are searching for answers, scientists want to understand what happened, and the entire world is trying to find you.
lines.tts: At first, you think you're dreaming. But governments are searching for answers, scientists want to understand what happened, and the entire world is trying to find you.

lines.text: But here's the strange part. The world doesn't stop. Women keep running businesses, hospitals, governments, and everything else.
lines.tts: But here's the strange part. The world doesn't stop. Women keep running businesses, hospitals, governments, and everything else.

lines.text: You're not suddenly in charge of the planet. You're just the biggest mystery on it.
lines.tts: You're not suddenly in charge of the planet. You're just the biggest mystery on it.
